vertical-spacing.description: No matching --ct-tag-list-vertical-spacing resolved value exists in civictheme.variables.css — tag-list.twig's vertical_spacing prop is implemented upstream via the shared, not-yet-ported 00-base/spacing utility, specifically its non-inset (margin, not padding) variant `.ct-vertical-spacing--*` (as opposed to `.ct-vertical-spacing-inset--*`, used by ct-accordion/ct-attachment/ct-callout/ct-iframe/ct-next-steps), whose base step is ct-spacing(3) = 8px * 3 = 24px (1.5rem) below the `l` (992px) breakpoint, doubling to ct-spacing(6) = 48px (3rem) at/above it. Value computed directly from that SCSS source (packages/sdc/components/00-base/mixins/_spacing.scss + 00-base/spacing/spacing.scss's $ct-spacing-map), not invented — and matches the resolved value ct-iframe/ct-basic-content already use for the padding variant of the exact same shared spacing scale.
